items.title: Meta Ordered to Pay $567 Million in Landmark Child Safety Ruling
items.summary: Meta Platforms Inc (NASDAQ:META) has been ordered by a New Mexico court to pay $567 million into a dedicated fund supporting initiatives to address harm experienced by young users, in one of the most significant legal decisions to date involving child safety and social media platforms.
